text: Finance Exception Intelligence.
zh: 财务异常智能。

text: Evidence into action.
zh: 从证据走向行动。

text: Monthly status.
zh: 查看月度监控状态。

text: Open Freight.
zh: 打开 Freight 预警。

text: A possible duplicate allocation needs finance review.
zh: 可能存在重复分摊，需财务核实。

text: Identify records, correct duplicates, rerun, and validate Freight and GP.
zh: 识别记录，修正重复分摊，重新运行，并验证 Freight 与毛利。

text: Review revenue, cost, and cost credit trends.
zh: 查看收入、成本和成本抵减趋势。

text: Now, investigate a separate allocation exception.
zh: 再看一个独立的分摊异常。

text: GA's month-three gross profit is negative.
zh: GA 第三个月毛利为负。

text: Ask why gross profit turned negative.
zh: 询问毛利为什么转为负数。

text: Follow the rules, true-up, revenue base, and source evidence.
zh: 依次追踪规则、轧差、收入基数和源凭证。

text: Open the negative revenue voucher.
zh: 打开负收入凭证。

text: Check amount, segment, user and reference.
zh: 核对金额、segment、入账人和参考号。

text: No matching positive entry is confirmed.
zh: 本样例尚未确认匹配的正向凭证。

text: LE's negative base raises GA's share and pressures GP.
zh: LE 负基数放大 GA 权重，影响毛利。

text: Compare excluding the voucher from the allocation base only.
zh: 比较仅将凭证排除在分摊基数之外的方案。

text: Posted revenue and months one and two stay unchanged.
zh: 已入账收入和前两个月的分摊结果不变。

text: GA improves; total GP unchanged; LE needs review.
zh: GA 改善，总毛利不变，LE 仍待核查。

text: Save the candidate and generate a report with evidence, assumptions, and actions.
zh: 保存候选方案，生成包含证据、假设和行动的报告。

text: Turn this saved proposal into accountable follow-up.
zh: 让这份已保存方案进入有负责人、有反馈的后续行动。

text: Assign an owner.
zh: 分派负责人。

text: Confirm receipt.
zh: 确认任务已接收。

text: Start work and track the handoff.
zh: 开始处理并追踪交接。

text: Record the outcome.
zh: 记录处理结果。

text: Ledger unchanged.
zh: 账务保持不变。

text: Next, understand the rules behind the numbers. Ask about report logic.
zh: 接下来理解数字背后的规则，询问报表逻辑。

text: The simulated answer streams from the selected knowledge base and links to its source.
zh: 模拟答案从所选知识库流式展示，并链接原文。

text: Explore built-in and personal knowledge.
zh: 查看内置和个人知识库。

text: Use that understanding to define your monitor. Choose the report, dimension and metric.
zh: 基于对规则的理解定义监控，选择报表、维度和指标。

text: Review the chart, then set a gross-profit threshold.
zh: 查看图表，再设置毛利阈值。

text: Add a revenue trend.
zh: 添加收入趋势。

text: Drag to arrange your monitors.
zh: 拖动卡片，调整监控布局。

text: Reuse templates.
zh: 复用监控模板。

text: Finance Exception Intelligence. From signals to accountable action.
zh: 财务异常智能：从监测信号走向可追踪的行动。
